title: Oh my gosh, it died on my second use...
text:
Oh my gosh, it died on my second use.... [[VIDEOID:64621a19eb08f587252445fbaf26fbf6]] Ok, first time making milkshakes with this and it died. I heard a snap, crackle, pop! Now, when I shake the red machine there is rattling inside. Sorry, I can’t recommend this. My milkshake was halfway done and when I added some more ice cream (it wasn’t to hard) it stopped! In addition, the digital touch display was confusing. Even when you set a speed the timer would come on. Very confusing display! So, I didn’t like much about this blender, especially the quality!

Trust you found this review honest and helpful:-)
